description: Certifies a DRAFT dossier, locking in all its associated evidence groups. The dossier must be in DRAFT status. After certification it transitions to CERTIFIED and a tamper-evident PDF is generated. Prerequisites: the dossier must exist (dossier_create) and have evidence groups linked. Use dossier_group_certify instead if you want to create + certify in one step from a single evidence group. Example: dossier_certify({ caseFileId: '...', dossierId: '...' })

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file that owns this dossier

dossierId.description: UUID of the dossier to certify (must be in DRAFT status)

name: dossier_certify
